# Bid the cracks, the tear-off, and the stories.

> Price a stucco or EIFS repair from crack linear feet, hollow area, tear-off to the substrate, stories and scaffolding, window flashing, color match, and moisture investigation — not a published price per square foot. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper crack-patch quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
